messages:
Lina (marketing): Quick post-launch recap for the RefApp snack article — we pushed at 9:05am PT. Traffic spike from Hacker News early, organic search picked up later. Thoughts on follow-up webinar? :coffee:
Jon (devrel): Nice! Numbers?
Lina (marketing): GA: 6.2k pageviews first 24h, 420 newsletter signups, 12 direct demo requests.
Alex (growth): Good conversion. Where are demo requests coming from? region / company size?
Sam (content): 8 of 12 from startups, 3 mid-market, 1 enterprise. Organic + Twitter thread referral.
Priya (ops): Are demo requests hitting CRM correctly? I saw 2 not routed.
route-bot: 2 leads failed routing due to missing 'company_size' attribute, defaulted to 'unassigned'.
Lina (marketing): Ugh, ok. Can we update mapping so missing company_size -> 'small' for now? Otherwise they sit in unassigned bucket.
Jon (devrel): Also, benchmark narrative needs a tweak — our latency numbers in the article were measured at batch=1; we should add a note for batched throughput so we don't overpromise.
Sam (content): Agreed. Suggest adding: "Latency numbers measured at steady-state (batch=1) on dedicated capacity; batched throughput improves tokens/sec. See appendix for full benchmark config."
Alex (growth): Also recommend a gated webinar: "How we built the RefApp: infra, benchmarks, and cost tradeoffs" — collect leads from demo requests and newsletter. Target 40-60 seats; add CTA on article.
Lina (marketing): Action list:
- Sam: update article copy + short bench explainer (EOD)
- Priya: fix routing mapping + reprocess the 2 missed leads (today)
- Jon: draft webinar outline + suggested speakers (tomorrow)
- Alex: set up CTA + registration page + initial ad budget (48h)
Priya (ops): For routing fix, do we map 'unknown' -> 'small' or 'unknown' -> 'manual review'?
Alex (growth): Manual review slows SDR. Map to 'small' but tag 'auto-assigned' so SDR can flag edge cases.
Priya (ops): OK will do. Running a re-ingest script: 
```bash
python scripts/reingest_leads.py --source=web --filter='missing_company_size'
```
Jon (devrel): For webinar speakers: propose Lina, me, and Rafael (runtime eng). Agenda: 15min demo, 20min bench deep-dive, 10min Q&A.
Sam (content): Messaging test: A/B two CTAs on the article — "Join live webinar" vs "Get the code + benchmark appendix". Track CTR -> signups.
Lina (marketing): Also plan registrant drip: 7d, 2d, 1d, 1h. Alex to own.
Alex (growth): Budget: $800 initial sponsored posts + $200 experiment on developer Twitter promos.
Lina (marketing): Any blockers?
Jon (devrel): Need Rafael to confirm availability, I'll ping @rafael.
Priya (ops): Routing fix deployed to staging, will push to prod after quick smoke.
Sam (content): I'll post the updated paragraph and append the bench notes in a follow-up edit.
Lina (marketing): Thanks — please update this thread when each item is done. :rocket:
